AttestationEntry.description: One name's latest attestation in an [`AttestationRecord`].

executionKey.description: The receipt attested; environment-wide, the desired commit of the state.

EnvironmentName.description:
An Environment's name, unique across declared Environments and all
template instances because leases, run refs, and keep refs are named
after it. A Kubernetes DNS label.

Uid.description:
The UUIDv7 of one incarnation of a unit. It fences every receipt,
checkpoint, and deletion.

UnitName.description:
A unit's literal `metadata.name`, unique per environment across all
unit kinds. A Kubernetes DNS label.

description:
The latest attestation per name of a unit's receipts,
`observed/units/<unit>/attestations.yaml`, or of an environment's state,
`observed/attestations.yaml`. One file per scope; `git blame` shows when
each name last changed. Contract:
[Attestations](../../../../design/orchestration-core.md#attestations).
title: AttestationRecord
